name: geoeq
tagline: Geotechnical engineering, solved in Python — 170+ validated functions for soil mechanics
description: geoeq is a Python package for geotechnical engineering with 170+ validated functions covering soil mechanics, SPT, CPT, bearing capacity, settlement, liquefaction, and slope stability. It is Apache-2.0 licensed and published on PyPI, built on NumPy, and aimed at practicing engineers who want transparent, scriptable geotech calculations instead of black-box spreadsheets.
highlights: 170+ validated functions across the core geotech workflow
SPT, CPT, bearing capacity, settlement, liquefaction, slope stability
Apache-2.0 with PyPI distribution and clean NumPy design
A rare open tool for a traditionally closed engineering niche
curatorNote: Geotech runs on spreadsheets and legacy software, so a validated, open, scriptable Python library is genuinely refreshing — a small niche, but one with real professional impact.
